name: aventura-das-notas
description: Jogo para aprendizado de notas musicais

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/build-android.mjs debug
scripts.aab: npm run sync && node scripts/build-android.mjs release
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:cliente
scripts.worker:deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.test:worker: node server/teste-e2e.mjs http://localhost:8787 && node server/teste-cliente.mjs http://localhost:8787 && node worker/teste-hinos.mjs http://localhost:8787 && node worker/teste-sugestoes.mjs http://localhost:8787
